name: nautilus-bot
description: Nautilus - Verifiable Memory Layer for dictation and meeting capture

scripts.lint: bun run typecheck && cargo fmt --manifest-path rust-sidecar/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust-sidecar/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.electron:build: bun run sidecar:build:release && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:electron && node scripts/build-electron-release.mjs build
scripts.electron:build:mac: node scripts/assert-host-platform.mjs darwin && bun run sidecar:build:release && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:electron && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: node scripts/assert-host-platform.mjs win32 && bun run sidecar:build:release && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.electron:build:dmg: node scripts/assert-host-platform.mjs darwin && bun run electron:build:mac && node scripts/build-dmg.mjs
scripts.electron:pack: bun run sidecar:build:release && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:electron && node scripts/build-electron-release.mjs pack
scripts.gate:launch-unblockers: bun run gate:release-credentials:preflight && node scripts/generate-launch-unblocker-pack.mjs && node scripts/verify-launch-unblocker-pack.mjs
scripts.gate:blockers:refresh: bun run gate:dictation:artifacts && bun run gate:launch-claims && node scripts/verify-dictation-app-matrix.mjs --out artifacts/dictation-app-matrix-gate.json --write-only && bun run gate:macos-app-matrix:preflight && bun run gate:qa-matrix && bun run gate:cloud-asr:preflight && bun run gate:license-live:preflight && bun run gate:windows-handoff && bun run gate:windows-handoff:verify && node scripts/refresh-blocker-artifacts.mjs && node scripts/export-qa-evidence-bundle.mjs --matrix docs/packaged-app-qa-matrix.md --out artifacts/packaged-qa-evidence-bundle.json && bun run gate:packaged-ux && node scripts/generate-launch-readiness-report.mjs && node scripts/verify-launch-readiness-report.mjs && bun run gate:competitive-readiness && bun run gate:production-readiness-markers && bun run gate:dead-code && bun run gate:doc-command-hygiene && bun run gate:blocker-register && node scripts/generate-completion-audit.mjs && bun run gate:launch-unblockers && node scripts/generate-completion-audit.mjs && node scripts/verify-completion-audit.mjs && bun run gate:launch-unblockers && bun run gate:secret-safe-artifacts && bun run gate:production-readiness-markers && bun run gate:dead-code && bun run gate:doc-command-hygiene && bun run gate:blocker-register
scripts.gate:completion-audit: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run gate:packaged-ux && bun run gate:dead-code && bun run gate:launch:report && bun run gate:competitive-readiness && bun run gate:secret-safe-artifacts && bun run gate:production-readiness-markers && bun run gate:doc-command-hygiene && bun run gate:blocker-register && sh -c 'node scripts/generate-completion-audit.mjs; bun run gate:launch-unblockers; node scripts/generate-completion-audit.mjs --strict; audit_status=$?; node scripts/verify-completion-audit.mjs; verify_status=$?; if [ $verify_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $verify_status; fi; bun run gate:launch-unblockers; unblock_status=$?; if [ $unblock_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $unblock_status; fi; bun run gate:secret-safe-artifacts; secret_status=$?; if [ $secret_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $secret_status; fi; bun run gate:production-readiness-markers; marker_status=$?; if [ $marker_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $marker_status; fi; bun run gate:dead-code; dead_code_status=$?; if [ $dead_code_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $dead_code_status; fi; bun run gate:doc-command-hygiene; doc_status=$?; if [ $doc_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $doc_status; fi; bun run gate:blocker-register; blocker_register_status=$?; if [ $blocker_register_status -ne 0 ]; then exit $blocker_register_status; fi; exit $audit_status'

author: NautilusBot
